resources.string: A unified entry for independent Google sign-in and Play Billing capabilities. Supply your OAuth / Firebase project and Play test products. No automatic login gate is imposed. Review prompts and independent feedback are in section 3.
Subscription (turn off for a one-time product)
Connect to Play and query offers
Enter a Web Client ID first.
Firebase is not configured. Add configuration resources as described in the module documentation. Google sign-in can be used independently.
Google account: %1$s\nEmail display only. The ID token must be verified by Firebase or your backend.
Signed out and cleared Credential Manager state.
No offers available. Check the Play test track, installed signature, account, and product configuration.
Available offers: %1$d. Select an offer to purchase.
Query the current product and select an offer first.
Open the Google Play purchase confirmation: %1$s\nPrice: %2$s
Play response code: %1$d. Success means the request was submitted; use Play callbacks and purchase recovery to determine the outcome.

Purchase status could not be verified. Check your network and restore purchases again.
